_comment: DSH multi-window launcher configuration for Yocheved's laptop (DESKTOP-FGV6KMH). ONE server, MANY windows. Copied from the owner's fleet config with the paths and the default workspace changed for this machine.

_modes.single: One DSH server on primaryPort; every window attaches to it. Sessions are independent; the engine is shared. THIS IS THE ONLY SUPPORTED MODE.
_modes.multi: UNSUPPORTED on a shared DSH_HOME - do not use. Two dsh web processes on one home have been observed writing duplicate sequence numbers into one session log and making the whole history unloadable. It is also ~1.4 GB per engine.

_notes.whyWorkspaceIsLptHub: The window workspace is the agent's default workspace root. It is set to the shop's records repo rather than the whole C:\Users\cheve\code so that the DEFAULT reach is the job, and the harness configuration the machine itself runs on is never inside a writable workspace root. The other repos (harness-config, personal-secretary-mvp) are still readable and usable from a session that needs them; this only decides what a fresh window opens on.
_notes.nodeTls: This machine sits behind the Techloq TLS-intercepting filter. Node must be told to trust the filter CA via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and must avoid IPv6 via NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first. Machine-scope environment variables are NOT reliably inherited by service-spawned processes on this box (measured 2026-09-14), so dshw-launch sets both explicitly.

_multiPorts._comment: Only read in mode 'multi'. Ports are assigned from basePort upward, in window order.

_dshInstall: THE ENGINE PIN, AND WHY THIS KEY IS MANDATORY ON THIS MACHINE. Added 2026-10-14. This machine's dshw.ps1 (blob aa4adcc5, 101033 bytes; the master lineage does NOT carry the fleet's 209335-byte revision) has NO dot-dsh-engine candidate in Resolve-DshBin. Its candidates are, in order: the DSH_BIN env var, the dshBin config key, the DSH_INSTALL env var, this dshInstall key, then profiles/node_modules under dot-dsh. Its own error text says to set dshInstall here or DSH_INSTALL. So a pin placed at the engine directory with this key absent is installed and then IGNORED, and the symptom reads as 'the pin changed nothing'. The pinned engine (0.2.0-rc.2, 288 packages, installed 2026-10-14) sits ALONGSIDE the 0.1.5 tree, which is untouched, so rollback is: remove this key, rename the engine directory, re-run ensure. Set per docs/incidents/2026-10-08-zabz-tech-engine-line-mismatch/README.md, where an engine on the wrong side of the version line produced a boot crash loop and an EMPTY WORKSPACE PICKER.
_engineSelection: ENGINE SELECTION. 2026-10-14: the 0.2.0-rc.2 pin at C:\Users\cheve\.dsh\engine (288 packages) is SELECTED. Reason it was briefly removed and is now back: selecting it was rolled back once because a headless one-shot on the pin exited 1 with 'dsh: TRANSPORT: DeepSeek Messages transport failed'. That was investigated properly and is a HEADLESS-PROFILE-ONLY symptom: the pin's WEB surface boots with 0 bytes of stderr on this box, and its host API answers every call 200 -- including /api/session/create returning ok:true with a real session id, /api/credentials/describe reporting DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configured:true, and /api/session/modelCatalog resolving deepseek-proxy / deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp. THIS KEY IS MANDATORY because this machine's dshw.ps1 has NO dot-dsh-engine candidate in Resolve-DshBin; without it the pin is installed and ignored. ROLLBACK, one step: remove this key, rename the engine directory, re-run ensure. The 0.1.5 tree is untouched.
